news.headline: DLF awards ₹325 crore flyover contract at Cyber City
news.summary: The flyover and four underpasses between Ambience Mall and Cyber City have Haryana and NHAI approval. Work starts after a traffic management plan is cleared and is scheduled for 18 months.

news.headline: DivyaSree launches ₹800 crore Yelahanka project
news.summary: DivyaSree Quiet Side is a five-acre, roughly 260-home three-tower development in North Bengaluru with a gross development value above ₹800 crore. Three-bedroom homes start at ₹2.99 crore all-inclusive.

news.headline: Lodha enters Delhi NCR with a ₹1,200 crore Gurugram office project
news.summary: Lodha Pantheon on Golf Course Road is a 27-floor, 4 lakh sq ft saleable office building on a 1.2-acre site, with floor plates of 13,000 to 25,000 sq ft. Investment is put at ₹1,100-1,200 crore.

news.headline: Pioneer Urban launches Alura Residences in Sector 62
news.summary: The project sits on 6.99 acres in Pioneer District and has about 250 homes of 7,000 to 15,000 sq ft in two towers. Investment exceeds ₹3,500 crore against expected sales above ₹9,000 crore.

news.headline: Mumbai luxury deals of ₹5 crore and above total ₹32,623 crore in April-September
news.summary: Lighthouse Luxury and Zapkey data show 3,145 Mumbai home deals at ₹5 crore or more in the six months to September. Knight Frank separately puts January-September residential sales at 72,804, the best for that span since 2018.

news.headline: Uttar Pradesh plans 500-acre 'Singapore City' near Noida airport
news.summary: The state plans the site in YEIDA Sector 7 to draw Singapore firms in logistics, data centres and semiconductors. Separately, a Singapore-group firm received an eligibility certificate for 50 acres in Sector 8D for a ₹775 crore packaging hub.

news.headline: KMC clears nearly 300 high-rises to resume work after safety audits
news.summary: A high-powered committee reviewed safety audits and developer undertakings, and 178 projects passed. Those with serious violations remain restricted until fixed.

news.headline: DLF gets MahaRERA registration for The Westpark Phase 2 in Andheri West
news.summary: The registration was granted on 30 October 2026 and a launch is expected in November. Phase 1 covers about 5.18 acres of a 10-acre master plan and has booked sales above ₹2,300 crore.

news.headline: Mindspace REIT signs 463,000 sq ft GCC lease at One Radial, Chennai
news.summary: Mindspace leased 1.6 msf in Q2 FY27 at an average Rs 94 per sq ft per month, with NOI up 31.9% and a record Rs 6.67 per unit distribution. Chennai now makes up about 10% of its asset value across Porur and Pallavaram-Thoraipakkam.

news.headline: Platinum lines up four Coastal Road belt projects worth over ₹1,350 crore
news.summary: Mumbai developer Platinum plans four residential projects in Khar, Santacruz and Versova with about 2.26 lakh sq ft of carpet area for sale. It needs ₹260 crore of investment, ₹160 crore of it from lenders including ICICI Venture, Bajaj Finance and AU SFB.

news.headline: Mumbai October registrations rise 9% to 12,690 (Knight Frank)
news.summary: Stamp duty collections rose 13% to Rs 1,173 crore, and monthly registrations have now stayed above 12,000 for nine straight months. January-October registrations total 1,32,040, up 7%; the Navratri dip reflected fewer effective registration days.

news.headline: Delhi declares its last 48 villages urban
news.summary: The Lieutenant Governor notified the villages as urban areas, giving civic bodies a legal basis to plan and fund services there. Building rules and approvals still apply, and the move follows the Master Plan for Delhi 2047 notification.

news.headline: Knight Frank: PE investment in real estate falls 31% to $1.66 bn
news.summary: Foreign money pulled back in January-September 2026 while domestic institutions supplied 85% of the capital. Offices still drew the most ($1.18 bn), with completed assets making up 78% of that.

news.headline: Embassy REIT pre-leases a 0.5 msf TechVillage building at a 15% premium
news.summary: A global engineering firm took an entire building at Embassy TechVillage, priced 15% above prevailing market rents. The REIT leased 1.5 msf in Q2 FY27, 85% of demand from GCCs, and paid a record Rs 7.07 per unit; Pune occupancy gained 300 bps.

news.headline: Data centres overtake offices as top private-equity target (Anarock-FICCI)
news.summary: Private equity put $6.1 bn into 55 Indian real estate deals in the first nine months of 2026, with data centres taking 40% ($2.5 bn) against $1.7 bn for offices. Mumbai holds 53% of operational data-centre capacity and Chennai 20%.

news.headline: Office leasing sets a nine-month record of 61 msf (JLL)
news.summary: Q3 gross leasing rebounded to 23.17 msf, led by Bengaluru, Hyderabad and NCR; BFSI hit its highest ever quarter. Vacancy rose 30 bps to 14.8% as the biggest post-pandemic supply quarter landed.

news.headline: IBM signs 2.83 lakh sq ft at Bagmane Solarium City
news.summary: Ten-year lease at ₹88 per sq ft, plus a separate fit-out rent of ₹2.98 crore a month for five years.

news.headline: DLF lines up launches worth over ₹58,000 crore
news.summary: Launches in Gurugram and Mumbai are planned over two to three years, with some in H2 FY27.

news.headline: New land notice for Metro Phase 3 Orange Line
news.summary: A third preliminary notification covers about 13,409 sq m along the JP Nagar 4th Phase corridor.
news.source: Metro Rail News, Phase 3 land notice

news.headline: DLF adds 7.48 acres in Sector 61, taking the parcel to 36 acres
news.summary: The additional land adjoins the parcel acquired from IREO in 2024; cost and launch timing were not disclosed.

news.headline: Sector 88A launch prices at ₹15,500 per sq ft
news.summary: Origen Realty's pre-launch is priced well above the locality average amid a wave of premium launches on the corridor.

news.headline: SMBC leases about 50,000 sq ft in BKC at ₹694
news.summary: Five-year lease in Sumitomo C65 with nine months rent-free and 15% escalation every three years; total rent about ₹189 crore.
news.source: HT via TradingView, SMBC BKC lease

news.headline: Cognizant takes 6.45 lakh sq ft at Embassy Splendid TechZone
news.summary: Five years at ₹74 per sq ft with 15% every three years, about ₹4.77 crore a month.

news.headline: Bengaluru led listed developers' land buying in FY26
news.summary: Anarock counted 17 deals over 293 acres, with Prestige, Puravankara, Godrej and Brigade all adding parcels.
news.source: Realty Promoo, Bengaluru land deals FY26

news.headline: Mall vacancy tightens to 4.8% as no new supply arrives (C&W)
news.summary: Q3 retail leasing was 2.22 msf; prime high-street rents rose 6.8% y-o-y. About 12.7 msf of Grade A mall supply is due by 2028.

news.headline: Co-working overtakes IT as the biggest office occupier (Anarock)
news.summary: Flex took 26% of 9M 2026 leasing, ahead of IT/ITeS at 25% and BFSI at 21%; pan-India vacancy eased to 15.15%.

news.headline: Hyderabad leasing up 50% to 13.1 msf in nine months (Knight Frank)
news.summary: Volume already exceeds any full year since 2018; flex operators more than doubled their take-up.

news.headline: Brookfield buys eight ESR industrial parks for ₹4,300 crore
news.summary: The portfolio spans 10.5 msf across 400 acres in Mumbai, Pune, NCR, Chennai and Kolkata, one of the largest logistics deals of the year.

news.headline: RBI raises repo to 5.50%, shifts to calibrated tightening
news.summary: First hike since February 2023; CPI projected at 5.2% for FY27 and GDP at 7.1%. The next MPC meeting is 2-4 December.

news.headline: Sunteck adds 4.5 acres in Borivali West
news.summary: A subsidiary bought land next to New Link Road, extending its western suburbs land bank.

news.headline: CBRE ranks Hyderabad first in Q3 absorption
news.summary: About 5.3 msf absorbed and 37% of India's GCC leasing; Colliers' methodology still puts Bengaluru ahead.

news.headline: Housing sales cross 1 lakh units again; prices up 7% (Anarock)
news.summary: Top-7 sales rose 3% y-o-y to about 1,00,200 units as launches jumped 18%; unsold stock climbed to 6.31 lakh units, an overhang of 19 months.

news.headline: Hyderabad carries the heaviest housing overhang at 28 months
news.summary: Launches more than doubled y-o-y while sales rose 15%; unsold stock is 1,14,700 units.

news.headline: Pune launches jump 48% in a quarter (Anarock)
news.summary: New supply ran well ahead of a 20% sales gain, lifting overhang to 17 months.

news.headline: Kolkata prices up 7% to ₹6,500 per sq ft
news.summary: Overhang is 22 months; 57% of launches are affordable or lower-mid.

news.headline: Kamdhenu buys 4 acres on Thane-Belapur Road for ₹150 crore
news.summary: The parcel carries 1.8 msf of potential for a Grade A commercial campus near the upcoming Pawane station.
news.source: Business Standard, Kamdhenu Navi Mumbai land

news.headline: Chennai vacancy falls to 10.4% (CRE Matrix)
news.summary: Demand ran at 1.9 times supply in H1 2026, among the tightest markets in India.
news.source: CREDAI-CRE Matrix India Office Q2 CY26

news.headline: Mumbai office vacancy at a 16-year low of 10.8% (JLL)
news.summary: Q2 leasing slowed but H1 volumes were up 17.8%; gross rents rose 3.4% y-o-y.
news.source: Real Estate Asia, JLL Mumbai Q2 2026

news.headline: Bengaluru vacancy rises to 11.4% on new supply (JLL)
news.summary: Q2 supply was 5.8 msf (+73% y-o-y) with low pre-leasing; rents still rose 5.4% y-o-y and yields compressed 20 bps.
news.source: Real Estate Asia, JLL Bengaluru Q2 2026

news.headline: Pune net absorption triples y-o-y in Q2 (JLL)
news.summary: 3.2 msf absorbed and 3.25 msf delivered; vacancy fell to 16.7% but rents rose only 1.1% y-o-y.

news.headline: Mindspace REIT raises ₹600 crore at a 7.49% coupon
news.summary: Listed NCDs priced near the March Embassy 10-year issue, keeping AAA REIT debt around 7.5%.
news.source: HDFC Sky, Mindspace Rs 600 cr NCD

news.headline: Kolkata warehousing leasing up 69% in H1 (Knight Frank)
news.summary: Fastest growth among the eight markets at 2.4 msf.

news.headline: HSBC subleases 2.03 lakh sq ft in HITEC City
news.summary: Rate of ₹315 per carpet sq ft with 5% annual escalation and 250 paid parking slots.

news.headline: Google commits ₹671 crore for 6.2 lakh sq ft at DLF Atrium Place
news.summary: Five-year lease at ₹171 per sq ft with 15% every three years; documents registered in April 2026.
